item.title: Lankh-Trained Alchemist
item.description: Trained in the style of alchemy familiar to Mortania. Initiate: May make royal glue, smoke bombs, firebombs, bitebane, and black ichor from memory, without needing to consume a formula.

item.title: Character Creation
item.description: Creating a character requires generating the basic abilities of your adventurer, understanding their cultural and upbringings, choosing a class, defining their allies, and preparing for adventure.

item.title: Armsmaster
item.description: You are exceptionally deadly in armed combat. Add your skill rank to damage with melee weapons.

item.title: Secrets of Xanthe
item.description: Most peculiar is that they are guides by the wisdom of “elders.” Late in their lives Xanthe fall into a terrible comatose fever, often resulting in death.

item.title: Secrets of the City of Miners
item.description: seek the grave of the Lawgiver .

item.title: Secrets of Blem
item.description: If asked the blemmyes will explain that their progenitor was sentenced to death for a terrible affront against the gods. But when the headsman came to issue the punishment he simply tucked in his head, causing the headsman to miss.

item.title: Secrets of New Lankh
item.description: The city of New Lankh did not exist until twenty years ago. During the last conjunction of the Wandering Moon the community appeared in its current location.

item.title: Secrets of the Beast Kingdoms
item.description: Chimericon <11,28> is the largest of the kingdoms of the Beast Kingdoms, however half a dozen other princes rule outlying holdings that range from small settlements to moderate castles.

item.title: Asterion
item.description: Holy Days High Holy Days 12th of Law Season: Triumph of Asterion - during this day a great feast is held along with the largest of the Labyrinth Games.
